strings.en: Even a rescue frame/　can pull this off!
Don't underestimate it just for rescue!
This thing can fight too!
Here they come, Raul!
Right! Let's go!
This is company work too!/　Hang in there, Raul!
Right! Let's go, everyone!
Target acquired.
All right, moving in!
Target is within range.
All right, let's go!
Despinis, handle the data collection!
Yes.
The frame's built tough,/　but please don't push it!
Yeah, I know!
Jua-Mu, don't underestimate the Excellence!
That person seems... lost?/　That's the feeling I get.
But we can't let our guard down. Not ever...!
If you can cut my Excellence, go ahead and try!
It's a Raig-Geios./　Those aren't a bioroid's maneuvers.
Then a veteran's piloting it...!
An even more intriguing opponent/　than Choukijin or Yokijin.
Just stick to gathering data!
I sense a deep darkness from Debudedabide...
He may not look it,/　but he serves Dark Brain...!
It can control Zovorg machines too...!
No life signs from the target.
Then I'll shoot it down!
I'd like to get a sample of its outer skin.
If any falls off later!
I sense the same waves from the Skull Knight/　as from Dark Brain...
Because it serves Dark Brain? Or...
Why does it speak in a Kansai accent...?
Taking that into account too, it's truly intriguing.
It'll take more than looks to scare us!
Keep your hands off our planet!
No discrepancies with the data we were given.
Raul, the Rest Rail is approaching.
Got it! Let's go!
Raul, don't get careless just because/　we've fought it before, okay?
I know!
Raul, please watch out for its range.
Don't underestimate the Kareitsedo's charging power.
Roger!
A Geios-Grude...!/　That's a bit of a nuisance.
Then if we strike first!
We'll draw the enemy's attention!
Got it!
Mizuho, just in case,/　get the Ex-Fairies ready!
Yes!
I don't know who you're with, but!/　I won't let you lay a hand on that super robot!
No matching data... Where's that unit from?
Raji, gather data on it!
Right.
Despinis, gather data on that unit, okay?
Understood.
Raul, the Thick Cylinder's coming!
Yeah, I'm engaging!
Big Shoulder ahead, locked on.
Got it, let's go!
Raul, I've locked onto the White Horn.
Roger! Engaging!
That thing's sluggish...!
Even so, it's a commander unit. We must be careful.
Raji, collect data on the Thorn!
Yes, I'm aware.
We need as much data on the Thorn as we can get...!
Yes, so we can work out countermeasures.
That unit is... dangerous...
Got it. I'll be cautious...!
Raji, that thing is...
A unit I've never seen.../　Probably a high-mobility type. Be careful.
To rescue the people who couldn't get away,/　I've got to take it down!
Normal Type Lamaris ahead!
Yeah, I'll wipe out every last one!
If anyone didn't make it out, tell me right away!
Understood!
If we leave it be, the damage will spread even more...!
The Kaana Type ahead has noticed us.
Too slow! First strike is mine!
I see.../　Jetzt... Its Einst-ification is progressing.
You're saying it can still change...?!
I think Arieil's prediction/　is correct...
Then inside that thing...!
Tit for tat!
I'm not soft enough to just/　sit here and take it!
I'm paying you back for that!
If I know where you are, I can hit you!
Take the bait and you're mine!
Proved the Excellence makes/　a good decoy too!
Now, here we go!
That was... my mistake!
This thing won't go down that easily!
Gwaaah!!/　The damaged area... This is bad!?
Kuh! This is too much, even for us!
I'll repair it using the Ex-Fairies!/　Despinis, help me!
If you get shot down, no pay for you!/　Repair costs add up, you know!
I know!
A d-direct hit!?
Even a Rescue Frame might not/　hold up against this.
No, it's still... It's still fine!
Ugh! This is really bad, Raul!
No excuses!/　Lend me your strength, everyone!
Tch! So its power's monstrous too!?
Ngh! So it doesn't look like that for nothing?!
Not just its looks--it hits hard too...!!
This is just a scratch for this unit!
It's fine, it still moves!
Gh...!/　I can still recover from this much!
All systems normal... I can still go.
Damn, I took that head-on!
Good thing it can repair itself,/　but there are limits!
Activating the repair system!
Sorry, I'm counting on you!
Left leg rear: thrusters 3 and 5/　are losing output!
Balancing us out with the Tesla Drive!
Hey! Get it together, Raul!
Mizuho, send the Ex-Fairies to the damaged areas!
Okay, starting repairs!
No way I'm getting overpowered by Jua-Mu!
Is this all the power it has...?!
Our data isn't complete./　We mustn't let our guard down.
So they have combat data on us too!
That's a commander unit for you./　Its firepower's insane...!
I guess that's a new model for you...?!
That power... It's more than the data said!
I can't let something like that possess me!
That Lamaris is getting more active!
Ngh! So what if you got bigger!
Combining sure made its attacks heavy...!
Didn't hurt, didn't hurt!
Attacks like that won't work on this one!
If it won't work, don't bother attacking!
The Exxelant isn't that flimsy!
I need to get to where I/　can dodge stuff like that...!
...! Is its attitude control failing?
This frame's useless unless it's sturdy.
This much won't affect us!
It's built tough, just as expected.
Just grazed me!
Don't fly it the same way/　as the other frames!
Despinis, where were we hit?
The left fire suppressant sprayer.
Good thing the frame's so tough!
But you mustn't rely on it too much.
I thought I'd dodged that...!
It can't be helped, it's a big frame.
Damn Jua-Mu, he landed one!
Even though we have their data...!
That's all you get from mass production.
I wasn't underestimating/　the Geios Series, but...!
Like I'd let some ghost get me!
I can't shake off the Lamaris...!
Has its accuracy improved...?!
The Kaana Type's got its teeth in me...!
Damn Ares Geist, it's faster than before...!
Brute force alone won't beat me!
Whoa!/　Any later and that would've hit me...
Where are you looking!?
You won't hit me that easily!
If I go down, I can't save anyone!
You won't hit me, Jua-Mu!
With all the data we have, it's easy to deal with!
As long as I know their patterns,/　even the Geios Series is no problem!
That's it, aim at me!
Your specs mean nothing/　if they can't hit me!
Like I'd lose to a monster!
Like a monster's attack could hit me!
Like I'd lose to the Lamaris!
All that swelling up made you sluggish!
Even if it's a Kaana type!
Even if it moves unlike a human!
We're the exterminators here!/　Not the other way around!
I keep up with my training too!
Too bad for you!
Avoiding danger's an important job skill too.
I have to keep the expenses down as much as I can...
Keep it up, Raul!
Yeah, that's the plan!
Whew, even its attack patterns/　have changed...
Couldn't dodge that.../　I've still got a long way to go.
Not with an attack like this!
No need to even dodge.
It's got features like this, too!
That won't work!
Not with an attack like that!
Ngh, I forgot to run the check...!
No good, I've pushed it too hard!
Ngh! I lost sight of the enemy!
Where did it go!?
I can't even attack from here...!
If I hit the same spot, I can do this!
Perfect timing!
I'll back you up with the Excellence!
If we aim for the same spot!
I'm still here!
Arado, leave the rest to me!
Hey, Arado! Where are you going!?
Seolla, I'm coming in too!
I'll cover you, Latune!
Rätsel, I'll cover you!
Major Sänger, I'll back you up!
Major Gilliam, I'm going in too!
Lamia, I'm going too!
If I follow the Lieutenant's lead.../　I can do this!
Lieutenant, I'll back you up!
Captain, I'll take it from here!
Following Ibis! Time for teamwork!
Ibis, I'm going too!
I'll help, Kota!
Axel, I'm right behind you!
Josh, leave the rest to us!
Rim, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Hugo, I'll back you up!
Lieutenant Aqua, I'll cover you!
Ing! Leave the rest to us!
I'll cover you, Touma!
Touya, leave the rest to me!
Lieutenant Calvina, I'll support you!
Akimi, I'm going in too!
Akemi, I've got your back!
Major Gilliam, I'll support you!
I won't let you have your way!
I can use the Excellence as a shield!
This frame is/　built to take a beating!
Look out!
Times like this call for the Excellence!
Time to show what Rescue does best!
This is the Rescue Frame's time to shine!
I'll protect them with the Rescue Frame!
I won't let you!
This frame's a tough one!
Arado! Watch your surroundings!
Seolla! Get out while you can!
Get out of there, Latune!
Rätsel, leave this to me!
Major Sänger, please fall back!
Fall back, Major Gilliam!
Get away, Lamia!
Covering the Lieutenant!
Captain, please pull out!
Ibis, go now!
Kota, don't push yourself!
Axel, get out of there, quick!
Josh, fall back!
Rim, get out of there!
Lieutenant Hugo, please fall back!
Lieutenant Aqua, please fall back!
Ing, fall back!
Touma, get away from there!
I'll cover Touya!
Get out of there, Second Lieutenant Calvina!
Akimi! You're too far forward!
Get away while you can, Akemi!
Raul, we can still push on!
Yeah, let's push through!
Raul, the lock is still holding.
All right, one more hit!
There!
You're mine!
I'll make this hit!
Take this!
Down you go!
Go down!
Charge complete! Now!
Waste Smasher, fire!
Target locked!
Waste Smasher!!
Don't miss, okay?
Right! Go-o-o!!
Commencing assault!/　Everyone, hold on tight!
Switching to high-speed maneuver mode.
Everyone, we're charging straight in!
Frame, mode change.
Crusher Arm, deploying field!
Take this! Gigant Crusher!!
Field deployed! You're good to go!
Gigant Crusherrrr!!
